event_title: US Tariff Escalation — China/HK Goods
description: US administration announced expanded tariffs on Chinese and Hong Kong manufactured goods effective February 2026. Tariff rates on key categories raised to 35-60%. Hong Kong government responded with diplomatic protests. Market impact: HSI declined sharply on announcement.
market_impact_note: HSI fell ~4% on announcement day. HK property sector most exposed due to mainland China demand linkage. Technology hardware supply chains disrupted.

event_title: China PBOC Emergency Rate Cut — 25bp
description: People's Bank of China cut benchmark lending rate by 25bp to support domestic demand amid trade war escalation. Seen as insufficient by markets.
market_impact_note: HK mortgage rates remained anchored to HIBOR. Property sentiment marginally positive short-term but structural concerns remained.

event_title: Strait of Hormuz Partial Disruption — Iranian Naval Exercise
description: Iranian naval forces conducted large-scale exercises in the Strait of Hormuz on February 14-18 2026 significantly disrupting commercial shipping transit. Approximately 30% of scheduled LNG tanker transits delayed. Oil prices spiked. Shipping insurance premiums surged 180% in one week. Baltic Dry Index fell as rerouting costs increased.
market_impact_note: Brent crude +8.4% in one week. Shipping sector equities fell 6-12%. LNG spot prices +22%. Dubai/UAE risk premium rose. Insurance market disruption. MENA equity markets declined 4-7%.
source_reference: Multiple wire services confirmed by Lloyd's of London market data 2026-02-14 to 2026-02-18

event_title: Hormuz Partial De-escalation — Maritime Safety Corridor Agreed
description: After international diplomatic intervention (US 5th Fleet + GCC joint statement), a limited commercial shipping safety corridor was agreed on February 20 2026. Full normalisation of transit volumes took until approximately March 15.
market_impact_note: Shipping equities partial recovery +3-5%. Oil prices retreated from spike. Insurance premiums remained elevated through March. LNG spot prices declined but stayed above pre-event levels.
source_reference: GCC Joint Communiqué 2026-02-20; Lloyd's confirmed corridor operational 2026-03-15

event_title: Federal Reserve Hold — No Rate Cut March 2026
description: US Federal Reserve FOMC meeting March 5 2026: rates held unchanged at 4.25-4.50%. Chair statement cited persistent services inflation and strong labour market. Market had priced ~40% probability of a cut.
market_impact_note: USD strengthened modestly. US 10Y Treasury yield rose 8bp. Risk assets sold off marginally.

event_title: HK Residential Property Market — Q1 2026 Transaction Data
description: HKSAR Rating and Valuation Department published Q1 2026 residential transaction data. Overall transaction volume fell 18% YoY. Average residential price index fell 4.2% from Q4 2025. Commercial/Grade A office market remained more resilient (-1.8%).
market_impact_note: HK property developer stocks fell 2-4% on data release. REIT sector broadly flat. Grade A office occupancy remained above 85%.
source_reference: HKSAR Rating and Valuation Dept Quarterly Report Q1 2026

event_title: US-China Trade Partial Truce — 90-day Tariff Pause Announced
description: Following G20 bilateral meeting, US and China announced 90-day tariff pause effective April 15 2026. Tariffs on selected technology and consumer goods categories suspended pending further negotiations. Seen as positive but fragile.
market_impact_note: HSI gained 5.8% on announcement. HK property sector +3.2%. Asia technology equities rallied. USD weakened slightly.

event_title: ECB Rate Cut — 25bp to 2.25%
description: European Central Bank cut deposit facility rate by 25bp to 2.25% at April 2026 meeting. Cited slowing European growth and easing inflation. EUR weakened modestly against USD.
market_impact_note: EUR government bond prices rose. EUR Corporate credit spreads tightened. EUR/CHF moved from 0.940 to 0.948.

event_title: Germany Economic Confidence Index — May 2026 Improvement
description: German ZEW Economic Sentiment Index rose to +38.4 in May 2026, above expectations. Industrial production data also beat consensus. First positive trend in 4 months.
market_impact_note: DAX gained 1.8% on release. EUR firmed. German 10Y Bund yield rose marginally.
source_reference: ZEW Research Institute Monthly Survey May 2026

event_title: China Housing Policy Package — Tier 1 Cities Stimulus
description: Chinese State Council announced comprehensive housing stimulus package on June 18 2026: reduced down-payment requirements for first-time buyers in tier-1 cities to 15%, state-backed mortgage at 3.2%, and relaxation of purchase restrictions for Hong Kong residents buying in Shenzhen/GBA.
market_impact_note: HK property sector +5.4% over 3 days post-announcement. Hang Seng Real Estate Index rallied. SHK Properties +4.1%. Link REIT +2.3%.

event_title: Hormuz Strait — Full Commercial Transit Normalisation Confirmed
description: US 5th Fleet and UAE Coast Guard jointly confirmed full normalisation of Strait of Hormuz commercial transit from July 1 2026. All categories of vessels operating without restriction. Insurance premiums returned to pre-event levels by July 10.
market_impact_note: Shipping equities broadly recovered. Oil prices stabilised. LNG spot prices fell back to near pre-February levels by July 15. MENA equities broadly flat.
source_reference: Joint US-UAE Maritime Statement 2026-07-01; Lloyd's Market Update 2026-07-10

event_title: HK Grade A Office Market — Mid-Year Update
description: JLL Hong Kong mid-year office market report: Grade A office vacancy rate 14.2% (stable vs Q1). Central sub-market vacancy 11.8%. Average rent -1.2% vs year-end 2025. Occupier demand stable from financial services but soft from tech/media.
market_impact_note: HK property REITs broadly stable. Office-linked equities limited reaction.
source_reference: JLL Hong Kong Office Market Research H1 2026

event_title: Federal Reserve Cut — 25bp to 4.00-4.25%
description: US Federal Reserve cut rates 25bp at August 5 2026 FOMC meeting. Cited easing inflation and moderating growth. Market had fully priced the cut.
market_impact_note: USD weakened. US 10Y yield fell 12bp. Risk assets broadly positive. HKD peg tested at lower bound briefly.

event_title: China Q2 2026 GDP Data — 4.2% Growth (below 5% target)
description: China's National Bureau of Statistics published Q2 2026 GDP at 4.2% growth YoY, below the official 5% target and below consensus of 4.6%. Trade war impact and property sector weakness cited.
market_impact_note: HSI fell 1.4% on release day. RMB softened. HK property names declined 1-2%.

event_title: Korea Semiconductor Export Controls — US Unilateral Action
description: US Commerce Department announced expanded semiconductor export controls targeting advanced chip manufacturing equipment exports to China, effective August 25 2026. Samsung and SK Hynix shares fell 8-12% in Seoul. TSMC Taiwan -6%. Nvidia -4%.
market_impact_note: Korea KOSPI Technology sub-index -9.1% in one week. Samsung specific exposure high. Global semiconductor supply chain uncertainty increased.
source_reference: US Commerce Department Federal Register Notice 2026-08-20

event_title: China PBOC Foreign Exchange Intervention — RMB Support
description: PBOC set daily RMB midpoint fix at strongest-ever level vs expectations, signalling resistance to further RMB depreciation. State banks seen selling USD. HKD remained within peg band.
market_impact_note: HKD stable within peg band. RMB stabilised. Hong Kong financials broadly flat.
source_reference: Bloomberg FX Desk citing PBOC mechanisms 2026-08-25

event_title: Baltic Exchange Shipping Rates — Tanker Sector Spike
description: Baltic Exchange published emergency shipping rate data February 16 2026: VLCC (Very Large Crude Carrier) spot rates spiked to $85,000/day from $32,000/day pre-exercise. LNG carrier spot rates +110%. Suezmax +45%.
market_impact_note: Direct negative for shipping operators routing through Hormuz. Positive for shipping companies with alternative route capacity. Al-Mansoori conglomerate shipping assets estimated impacted.

event_title: Saudi Aramco H2 2026 Dividend Guidance — Maintained
description: Saudi Aramco confirmed H2 2026 base dividend unchanged at $0.099 per share. Performance-linked dividend subject to H1 results. Market viewed as positive signal for Gulf energy stability post-Hormuz.
market_impact_note: Aramco sukuk spreads tightened. MENA energy equities stable to slightly positive.

event_title: EU AI Act Implementation — Phase 1 Compliance
description: EU AI Act Phase 1 compliance requirements came into effect June 5 2026 for high-risk AI systems in financial services. Banks and asset managers required to document AI model risk assessments.
market_impact_note: Operational compliance focus. No immediate market impact. Medium-term cost consideration for EU financial firms.
source_reference: EU Official Journal AI Act Implementation Notice 2026-06-05

event_title: Hong Kong Government Budget Revision — Fiscal Stimulus HK$50bn
description: HKSAR Financial Secretary announced HK$50bn fiscal stimulus package on August 1 2026: infrastructure spending, stamp duty relief on residential properties, and support for financial services sector. Seen as response to slower GDP growth.
market_impact_note: HSI +1.6% on announcement. HK property sector +2.4%. Positive for LTV and collateral valuations for property-secured loans.
